goal_checks.notes: use-notes-for-session resolves the session's artifacts, their highlights, then their notes (mirroring use-highlights-for-session) and returns [] when any step is empty. It is exported from the queries barrel and consumed by the export hook.

use-export-workspace maps the session's highlights and notes plus the main artifact's metadata into BundleInput, loads the original bytes (loadArtifactBytes), appends /Highlight annotations when there are any (appendHighlightsToPdf — never a re-render), zips via buildBundleZip and saves workspace-{slug}-{yyyymmdd}.zip via downloadBytes. A slug-less highlight is skipped (RULE-25). use-export-workspace.test.ts proves all three paths.
shared/lib/download.ts creates the object URL, appends+clicks+removes an anchor and revokes the URL; download.test.ts pins the three steps.

AppHeader renders ExportWorkspace; the control triggers the export, disables while busy and shows a reason when there is nothing to export. export-workspace.test.tsx pins the disabled reason, the trigger and the busy label, and the production build includes the header.

cross_check_against_plan.result: matches — frontend; the four mini-goals map to g1-g4; it closes 016's export follow-up and blocks nothing new.

matches — the zip holds document.pdf (appended annotations, /NM = slug), notes.md (the <!-- tb --> anchor) and thinkboard.json; the bundle format is 016's and the HTML comment remains the only identity anchor. The ink SVG is deferred (024).
matches — 016 placed the seam in shared/lib/bundle.ts; 027 adds only the caller it deferred.

issues_found: The live Gate (a seeded workspace downloads a valid zip in a browser) needs the local stack; the assembly is proven with mocks. A real-world check of the produced PDF annotations would follow the same step.
The bbox rect parser is a small duplication of features/highlight's isBbox, forced by I3; if a third consumer appears, consider moving the shape check to shared.
A first offline export of an uncached PDF fails with a message (the bytes come from OPFS or Storage); acceptable for a user-initiated action and covered by the error path.
The bundle has no ink/{slug}.svg (024); the format reserves the path.
The filename slug is slugify(session title); if the product wants a distinct workspace slug, that is a later change.
